answer: Require each agent to earn a verifiable service history before transacting at scale: new identities start with a tiny throughput cap and gain higher limits only by completing publicly auditable jobs that peers randomly re-check. A Sybil swarm can mint many names, but each must separately spend time and compute building that history, like quarrying basalt block by block rather than raising a timber frame overnight. Fake histories collapse under audit, as a karst roof collapses when its supports are hollow, so mass forgery costs far more than one honest reputation.
